name: Red Wings Widget
description: Detroit Red Wings NHL schedule widget + companion app: next-game countdown, last result, and division standings.
changelog: Fix(Startup): Harden Firebase initialization with safe try-catch fallbacks and immediate defaults, preventing launch crashes and ensuring 100% offline resilience on Android.
Fix(CI): Prepare google-services.json template on GitHub Actions so APK release builds succeed without missing credentials.

Phase 1 (Operational Stability & Telemetry): Firebase Remote Config dynamic polling (4h off-day, 30m pre-game, 60s live), WidgetCrashGuard (<800KB Parcel ceiling) preventing TransactionTooLargeException, and Crashlytics non-fatal fallback telemetry.

Phase 2 (Generative Intelligence): Firebase AI Logic (Gemini on Android) with pre-game matchup previews & key battle intel in NextGameHero, post-game 3-stars commentary & dynamic recap pills in LastResultCard, and 82-game pacing projections in DrwSeasonLeadersCard, backed by instant offline heuristics.

Phase 3 (Real-Time Fan Community): Cloud Firestore distributed sharded counter (10 shards, 1500ms debounce) for interactive 'Light the Lamp' stadium goal horn cheering, anonymous auth, cross-device jersey preferences sync, and Room live score mirroring.
Reorder DRW season stat leaders to Goals, Assists, Points (interactive switcher tabs, default selection, and data models updated).

Underneath the 3 Stars, add standalone Frosted Glass card bubble displaying season stats for the Top 5 Detroit Red Wings in Points, Goals (Scoring), and Assists with interactive segmented switcher, medal rank badges, and headshots.
Fix away team logo rendering: add persistent on-disk logo caching, resolve ESPN URL slugs (LAK, SJS, TBL), implement parallel pre-fetching, and generate team color crest badges on offline fallback.
Under Last Result in the Compose companion application, display the 3 Players of the Game (Three Stars) with official NHL CDN headshot photos, player names, star indicators, and game stat lines.
Strictly locked widget to 4x2 cell size with resizing completely disabled (android:resizeMode=none).
Tailored pixel-perfect Concept 2 Frosted Ice mockup duplication for Google Pixel 10 Fold dual screens.

Outer cover display 4x2 (~330x140 dp) features seamless Home Red sweater header with dual racing stripes, circular crest badge, floating crimson @ puck badge, frosted matchup card with Away & Home records, floating Little Caesars Arena venue pill, and Playoff Seeds (with glowing red Detroit pill) + In The Hunt standings.
Inner unfolded display 4x2 (~540x170 dp) scales typography, crests, and seed pill spacing across the expansive inner screen without stretching or distorting.
Dynamic RemoteViews size-mapping on Android 12+ automatically selects the optimal layout when folding and unfolding.
Preserved pure white text and specular borders for WCAG AAA contrast across all screens.
